'''Ahto City''' was a [[city]] on [[Manaan]],<ref name="ZeroCompany" /> an [[ocean]] [[planet]] that was the [[homeworld]] of the [[Selkath]] [[species]].<ref name="DB">{{Databank|manaan|Manaan}}</ref>  The [[Jedi]] [[Rawn Shonson]] and his [[Rawn Shonson's master|master]] were assigned to a [[Unidentified outpost (Manaan)|small outpost]] on Manaan when [[Order 66]] was issued<ref name="ZeroCompany" /> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> naming all Jedi traitors to the [[Galactic Republic]]. Shonson survived the ensuing [[Great Jedi Purge|massacre]] of much of the [[Jedi Order]] and began frequently traveling in Ahto City under the alias "Arro Kontrera," the name of a fictional character Shawson had made up [[Standard year|years]] earlier with other Jedi [[youngling]]s including [[Tel-Rea Vokoss]]. Shonson's final journey in Ahto City was to leave for the planet [[Boz Pity]] and he [[Death|perished]] on the planet [[Dantooine]]<ref name="ZeroCompany" /> in [[18 BBY]].<ref name="ZeroCompanyDate">{{ZeroCompanyDate|empire=1}}</ref>

{{GameMechanics}}
After discovering Shawson's corpse on Dantooine, Vokoss—now a member of the [[mercenary]] [[Zero Company]]—visited Manaan to try and retrace her fellow Jedi's steps. She searched the outpost and recognized the alias "Arro Kontrera" in the Ahto City transit logs, which directed her to Boz Pity.<ref name="ZeroCompany" />
{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Ahto City.png|thumb|right|250px|Ahto City in ''Star Wars'' Legends]]
In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Ahto City was mentioned in the [[2026]] [[Bit Reactor]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Zero Company]]''. The mention occurs in the optional operation "Rawn's Fate," which is only avaliable if Tel-Rea Vokoss is alive in the player's crew.<ref name="ZeroCompany" /> [[Ahto City/Legends|Ahto City]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it first appeared in the [[2003]] [[BioWare]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>
